question: National Handloom day is celebrated every year on ________.
solution:
The correct answer is "**7th August**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **2015**, Prime Minister **Narendra Modi **declared National Handloom Day on **7th **of** August**. 
 
• Handloom industry contributed in the development of **socio-economic development** and create awareness about the sector.
 
• The handloom sector is one of the** largest economic** sectors in the country.
 
• The theme of National Handloom Day **2022** is **“Handloom, an Indian legacy”.****​__**

**__​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• This movement encourages the Indians to wear the clothes made by handlooms.
 
• The textile ministry will be celebrating National Handloom day at **Dilli Haat** which is celebrated from **August 1 to August 15.**
 
• On this day in **1905, that the Swadeshi Movement** was launched in the Calcutta Town hall to protest against the partition of **Bengal by the British Government.****​__**
